announcement.quote: The Fund's Board of Trustees has approved a proposal to reorganize the Fund into a newly created closed-end interval fund (the "Interval Fund").

outcome_evidence.quote: announced today the completion of the reorganization (the “Reorganization”) of Invesco Dynamic Credit Opportunities Fund (NYSE: VTA) (the “Fund”) into a newly created closed-end interval fund, Invesco Dynamic Credit Opportunity Fund (the “Interval Fund”).

deals.notes: The acquirer is a newly created interval fund (shares priced daily at NAV, quarterly repurchase offers), not exchange-listed, so not a listed pair. For the record the reorganization was completed on 2021-11-01 after shareholder approval on 2021-09-03 and a 20% cash tender offer (VTA delisted from the NYSE on 2021-10-28 per the 2021-10-13 release).
